slots.jd.publishing-startup.about:
About the role
Lumen Reader is a digital publishing startup building a reading app people actually want to open. We're looking for a mobile developer who likes shipping, cares about readers, and is happy owning features from idea to release. You'll work closely with a small team, have a real say in how the app grows, and see your work in readers' hands quickly.
slots.jd.publishing-startup.duties:
What you'll do
- Find and fix accessibility issues so every reader can use the app comfortably
- Handle API integration between the app and our content and account services
- Build and improve offline sync so readers can keep reading without a connection
- Work with design and backend teammates to plan, build and ship new features
- Keep the codebase tidy, tested and easy for the next person to pick up
slots.jd.publishing-startup.needs:
What we're looking for
- 4 or more years of experience building mobile apps
- Strong Swift skills and hands-on experience with App Store release
- Solid Kotlin experience and comfort working with Gradle builds
- Experience automating builds and releases with Fastlane
- Push notifications experience across both mobile platforms
slots.r1.b1: Resolves accessibility issues flagged through crash reporting and screen reader checks, reducing accessibility-related crashes by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Shortens app start-up time in Swift by moving non-critical work off the launch path and loading resources on demand.
slots.r1.b3: Builds offline sync for the mobile app and automates its test builds with Fastlane, cutting sync failures by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Maintains the release pipeline in Xcode, standardising build settings and signing so each release ships from a consistent configuration.
slots.r1.i1: Builds and tests mobile apps at Fairhaven Works, with a focus on device testing across a range of phones and operating system versions.
slots.r1.i2: Develops mobile features at Fairhaven Works, connecting app screens to backend services through API integration.
slots.r2.b1: Triaged crash reports for screens built with Jetpack Compose, fixing recurring state bugs and reducing crash volume by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Ran device testing across phones and tablets, using Firebase to collect results and catch layout and performance issues before release.
slots.r2.b3: Integrated new backend APIs and shipped them through each App Store release, cutting data-loading errors by 35 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Fixed accessibility issues in screens backed by Core Data, adding screen reader labels for locally stored content.
slots.r2.i1: Supported mobile development at Brightwater Labs, working mainly on API integration between the apps and backend services.
slots.r2.i2: Contributed to mobile apps at Brightwater Labs, helping build offline sync so users could keep working without a connection.
slots.summary.1: Mobile app engineer with about 4 years of experience owning a workstream end to end, from design through release. Builds Android features in Kotlin, backed by Firebase services and GraphQL APIs.
slots.summary.2: Mid-level mobile developer with about 4 years of experience taking a single service or workstream from planning to production. Works across Kotlin, Firebase and GraphQL, with a focus on reliable releases and maintainable code.
